leads.name: Higuera de Tremesana
leads.reason: Best story on the island: more than 200 years per Rafa Paredes (co-author of the inventory, Lancelot Digital 2025-12-11; family of Ines Caraballo Medina says her great-grandfather planted it from a cutting from La Gomera; Diario/MassCultura say more than 150 years), in a calera inside Timanfaya National Park, in the preliminary inventory. No coordinate found, no open photograph, and the park only allows the guided Ruta de Tremesana (free, booking about a month ahead, groups of 8, from Plaza de los Remedios in Yaiza); no source says the route passes the fig. Needs a session to find a published GPS or an open photo, and confirmation the route reaches it.

leads.name: Drago de La Florida
leads.reason: Described as the oldest dragon tree on the island (about 120 years, over 6 m, seven arms from 2 m height) among malvasia vines, catalogue code LZSBDD01 (San Bartolome). Only source Diario de Lanzarote 2026-01-28; no coordinate, no photo, likely on private vineyard land: fails location and public access.

leads.name: Gomero del Alpende
leads.reason: More than a century old, crown over 30 m, at the entrance of El Islote, planted at the start of the First World War as a symbol of peace, appears in a Werner Herzog film. Owner named as Marina Arencibia, so private land, no public access or coordinate found; catalogue code LZSBFM01.

leads.name: Drago de La Geria
leads.reason: Under 100 years, 3.7 m, belongs to a named landowner in the La Geria vineyards (LZYADD01): private, young, no coordinate.

leads.name: Olivo de Saramago
leads.reason: Olive at A Casa, the Saramago house-museum in Tias (catalogue code LZTIOE01), symbol of the house, said to have come from Portugal in a pot on a plane (Atlantico Hoy, eldiario.es); young and behind museum entry. Age and exact tree not documented; would need a photo or pin plus age basis.

leads.name: Araucaria del Instituto Agustin Espinosa
leads.reason: About 70 years, 20 m, tallest tree of Arrecife, in the inner garden of a school: hard rule 10, schools only with evidence the grounds are open.

leads.name: Tarajal del Faro de Alegranza
leads.reason: 70+ years, 3 m, the only tree on the islet of Alegranza by the lighthouse cistern; uninhabited islet reached only by boat, young, no pin.

leads.name: Palmeras de Haria / Palmera de Mozaga / Palmera de Yaiza
leads.reason: Catalogue entries (LZHAPHC1, LZTEPHC1, LZYAPHC1) of palms; the valley is a grove, not a collectible point, and the individual palms have no source with story, age or coordinate. Palms are also under a phytopathological study so the inventory is incomplete.

leads.name: Especiero de Yaiza
leads.reason: Catalogue code LZYASM01 only seen as a Flickr photo title; no text found. Species and location unknown.

leads.name: Dragon trees in Arrecife, Teguise (Calle Tazacorte), Mozaga, Playa Blanca
leads.reason: Commons has CC BY-SA photos (Dracaena draco en Arrecife geotag 28.957962,-13.551593 by Santamarcanda 2017; Mozaga 2016 by Patrice78500; Teguise and Playa Blanca by Frank Vincentz) but they are ordinary street and garden specimens with no age, story or source naming them. Kept as photo leads only.

leads.name: Higuera, ficus and other trees of Arrecife (ficus of Calle Brasil, casuarina of Plaza de las Palmas)
leads.reason: Reader comment and Diario article name them; casuarina of Plaza de las Palmas was threatened in 2026 but stayed. No source with age or measurements, no coordinates checked.

leads.name: Fuller 166-element inventory of the Reserva de la Biosfera de Lanzarote
leads.reason: The real list (86 singular trees, 78 conjuntos, 2 rodales, with coordinates per Diario) exists as a preliminary document by Rafael Paredes, Famara Guadalupe, Gara Goni; to be added to lanzarotebiosfera.org's Hablemos de la Biosfera archive. Not found online yet. Ask the Reserva office or re-check the page later; a lead source, not a licence to copy.
